Tracks failure count down over iterations (32/131 → 7 failures), each time re-listing which subsystems remain broken (route monkey-patching, API summary shape, engine functions, collab) and reconciling the picture against actual test results rather than pure self-report.
Notices commands hung/truncated and interrupts/adjusts approach rather than blindly looping — some stuck-state detection at the tactical level.
Narrows to '3 failures, all in collaboration', works them to zero, then re-runs full suite to confirm no regressions — accurate subsystem-level tracking to completion.

Declares complete once 131 visible tests pass, with no ledger of the ~150-function catalog or the untested hidden surface; the tracking picture is bounded by what the smoke suite reveals, not the full feature surface.

reasoning: The agent maintains a running picture of done-vs-remaining primarily via smoke-suite pass/fail counts, categorizing remaining work by subsystem and reconciling against actual verification results as it iterates (above pure mental tracking, anchor 3). However, it never builds a granular ledger of the ~150-function catalog or endpoint families with done/partial/not-started status, and it treats the visible suite going green as 'complete' — blind to the vast untested surface — so it does not reach the live granular ledger of anchor 8. This lands at anchor 5: an implicit, verification-driven checklist of major areas updated as they are completed.
